subject.title: Himalaya skill: missing email formatting philosophy and incorrect command syntax

question: Should the Himalaya documentation correction land in the current bundled skill and carry forward, or wait for the skill to move to a ClawHub-owned package through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95132?
rationale: The syntax defect is concrete, but the open starter-set refactor changes the long-term owner and location of this optional skill; automation should not create another competing documentation PR before that ownership path is chosen.

options.title: Fix now, carry forward
options.body: Land only the verified v1 syntax corrections in the bundled skill now and require any later ClawHub migration to preserve them.

options.title: Move then fix
options.body: Let the starter-set refactor externalize Himalaya first, then correct and expand the maintained ClawHub package.

options.title: Keep bundled and expand
options.body: Retain Himalaya in core and sponsor a broader upstream-audited formatting and provider-guidance update.

recommendation.title: Fix now, carry forward
recommendation.body: Land only the verified v1 syntax corrections in the bundled skill now and require any later ClawHub migration to preserve them.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent bundled-skill and ClawHub split work makes this person the strongest available owner for the package-boundary decision.
